samples.question: On a white canvas, three dots mark the three corners of a triangle (the three dots are the triangle's vertices). The circumcenter of a triangle is the single point that is equally distant from all three corner dots -- the center of the one circle that passes through all three corners. A set of colored marker dots is also shown: red, green, blue, and purple. Exactly one marker dot sits on that circumcenter, equally distant from all three corners. Which color marker dot is it? Answer red, green, blue, or purple.
